summary: For every real symmetric 3x3 compression G=[[E,v],[v^T,beta]] with E invertible indefinite and det G=0, G has rank two/inertia (1,1,0). For iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] original coordinates, x^T G x factors into two linearly independent linear forms whose joint density is bounded below near the origin, so its product density diverges logarithmically. Hence an exact indefinite Schur-lightcone scalar core cannot by itself admit a law-uniform bounded-density theorem; a full-target argument must retain an external third smoother. This does not refute QFORM because the core has only two nonzero eigenvalues.
scope_note: Source-valid original-coordinate product-law obstruction. It strengthens the prior single example by covering every singular member with an invertible indefinite endpoint block.
